stem: Ravi's class in Pune is studying why Earth supports life. His teacher asks which human action directly adds greenhouse gases to the air and so disturbs the balance that keeps Earth suitable for living things. Which action should Ravi choose?

options.text: Burning coal and petrol in factories and vehicles
Planting trees along the school boundary
Using rainwater harvesting tanks at home
Separating wet and dry waste for composting

teacher.key_rationale: Burning fossil fuels such as coal and petrol releases greenhouse gases that trap heat and disturb Earth's life-supporting balance. Options B, C and D are protective actions (afforestation, water conservation, composting) that support rather than threaten the balance, so A is the only correct choice.
